title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Rate Schedule Credited Back on a Room Change
content:
**Finance office clarification — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The come-off schedule of a room-change credit — which private pay schedule's rate is given back — follows how the old room's charge was priced.

| How the charge was priced | Come-off schedule |
|---|---|
| Standard charge basis, span beginning on or after 1 July 2026 (the current schedule's effective date) | The current private pay schedule |
| Prior-rate notice-hold charge basis | The preceding schedule |
| Any other charge | The schedule that governed the agreement's own rate on the recorded move date: the current schedule once the agreement's rate notice had run its 60 days by that date and that date falls on or after 1 July 2026, the preceding schedule otherwise |

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**Points of judgement (hypothetical).** A first-month partial charge, notice delivered 75 days before a recorded move falling after 1 July 2026: current schedule. The same charge with the notice delivered 40 days before the move: preceding schedule. A charge with the isolation charge basis whose span began on 1 July 2026: third row, read from the recorded move date.
